verdict_note: The target outcomes are sound and reproduce: in my own clone at 9fa5e52, extract/codecs/diagram/evidence/derive for M3 reproduce the smoke outputs byte for byte. `holon run` on the four laws gives I67-P1-P4 as predicted, with records equal up to seconds across two runs. `holon replay-go` gives a byte-identical report on every run. 14 cheap contract tests plus R1 and Y2 pass. The blob clones share one cell map ((32, 0), init 0), use a plain `i < 4096` test, have no condition over memory the loop writes, no narrow arithmetic and no defer. So none of the findings below touches the three REFUTED records or the UNKNOWN one. But Y6 claims a whole class of Go loops, and the generator and replay are wrong on parts of that class without refusing them. Blocking (B1): for a law over two ops whose loop bodies read different cells, Bend accepts a counter-law in a model that is not an abstraction of any carrier value. holon replay-go then runs each op on its own concretization and reports 'passed' with obstruction_observed true, for two ops that are equal in Go on every input. Major: in five more verified classes the model differs from Go without being refused: stale loop memory (M1), dropped carrier writes (M1), narrow integer wraparound (M2), and a deferred recover the frontend flagged as debt (M3). Each produced a Bend-accepted false REFUTED; the replay catches these (failed, so F1 model_defect). The replay's concretization ignores the loop's init, so a correct REFUTED replays on the wrong blob and fails (M4). decide() can raise Unsupported out of `holon run` (M5). The 0.2 loop bodies of range loops and offset tests assume init <= phi, which is false on the first iteration, so they lose reachable panics (M6). Each finding was reproduced with the real frontend, generator, Bend and replay (see evidence); fixes go into the generators.

findings.where: holon/gen/goloop.py:639 (decide: only trip counts compared); holon/goreplay.py:75 and :257 (one concretization per op)
findings.what: A law naming two ops is decided on one shared cell list, but each op's model reads 'cell k' as its own param[a*(init+k)+c]. decide() only refuses differing trip counts (n_cells); it never checks that the named ops share the stride a and base a*init+c. When they differ, the cell list is not a function of a carrier value, so a Bend-accepted counter-law of a weak or domain law does not refute anything about the Go functions. goreplay makes it worse: build() calls concretize(shapes[o], cells) per op, so each op runs on a different carrier value. The side then 'passes' with obstruction_observed true. Y9 says 'the carrier value ... It runs each op the law's claim names on it', one value per law. The status is a false REFUTED with a passed replay, so it survives F1 and reaches the go_only/pending bin as an observed obstruction. Since every two ops of a component with one result tuple get an E6 atom (Y4's note), every such pair gets weak and domain laws.
findings.evidence: Reproduction (reviewer's own clone /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/clone at 9fa5e52; nothing under /home/user/HOLON touched): the synthetic Go module /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/syn (module syn; carrier syn/carrier.Blob = [256]byte; git-committed), a 0.2 frontend config at clone/spec/M97/lib/go_frontend.json pointing at it, `python3 -m holon extract go --milestone M97 --out-dir /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/synout`, the document copied to clone/spec/M97/facts/syn.go.extracted.json; then /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/scripts/drive.py (builds one Go-op document per group with holon.diagram.goops.document, runs holon.gen.goloop.shapes, generate, CompiledModel.build and decide with holon.mpipeline's write_pair and accepted, i.e. the real Bend check) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/scripts/replay.py (writes synthetic laws/results under M97 and runs holon.goreplay.build, i.e. the real generated Go test on a scratch copy of the module). Group 'pair': syn/pa.Check loops i<4 and panics when i==2 && b[i]==7 (read (1,0)); syn/pb.Check panics when i==1 && b[i+1]==7 (read (1,1)). Both panic iff b[2]==7. A Go test (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/syncheck/check/check_test.go, 1536 blobs) confirms they agree on every blob tried; at b[2]=7 both panic, at b[3]=7 both return. Result: L_par_weak_pa_Check_pb_Check REFUTED (bend ALL PROOFS CHECK) at witness [0,0,7,0], difference OPanic/ORet. L_par_dom_ok_pa_Check_ok_pb_Check REFUTED at the same witness. holon.goreplay.build gives both laws status 'passed', obstruction_observed true, detail {pa_Check: 'panic:seven', pb_Check: 'ok'}: pa ran on b[2]=7, pb on b[3]=7.
findings.fix: In goloop.decide (or emit), refuse with UNKNOWN and a reason ('the ops the law names read different cells') any law whose named ops differ in (a, a*init+c, n). Compute the trip-count gate over the named ops only. In goreplay, build one carrier value per law from that shared map, at a*(init+k)+c, and run every named op on it; give not_run if the maps differ. Settle Y6/Y9 by amendment (Q1).

findings.where: holon/frontends/go/paths.py:364 and :379 (load of fresh memory folds to the type's zero), :659 (a store through the parameter is dropped), :507-522 (run_loop keeps loop-written memory as at entry)
findings.what: Memory the loop writes is read as at the loop's entry, as Y1 says. A condition over such memory therefore folds with the stale constant: fresh allocations read as 0 or false, so the condition never reaches Y6 and silently selects one branch. Stores through the carrier pointer are dropped altogether, even in the same iteration or before the loop: a later read of b[i] is the original cell. The model then has panic or error paths that Go never takes, or lacks ones Go takes, and nothing refuses the op. Y1's parenthetical, that Y6 reads conditions over the induction variable and cells only, does not protect against this.
findings.evidence: Reproduction (reviewer's own clone /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/clone at 9fa5e52; nothing under /home/user/HOLON touched): the synthetic Go module /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/syn (module syn; carrier syn/carrier.Blob = [256]byte; git-committed), a 0.2 frontend config at clone/spec/M97/lib/go_frontend.json pointing at it, `python3 -m holon extract go --milestone M97 --out-dir /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/synout`, the document copied to clone/spec/M97/facts/syn.go.extracted.json; then /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/scripts/drive.py (builds one Go-op document per group with holon.diagram.goops.document, runs holon.gen.goloop.shapes, generate, CompiledModel.build and decide with holon.mpipeline's write_pair and accepted, i.e. the real Bend check) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/scripts/replay.py (writes synthetic laws/results under M97 and runs holon.goreplay.build, i.e. the real generated Go test on a scratch copy of the module). syn/pc.Flag2 has `var done [1]bool; out := make([]byte,2)` and in the loop `if b[i]==5 {continue}; if b[i]!=0 {err}; if !done[0] {out[i]=1; done[0]=true}`. In Go, out[i] is written only at i==0, so it never panics. The 0.2 body has a panic path [cell==0, iv>=2] at pc/pc.go out[i]. L_par_tot_pc_Flag2 is REFUTED by Bend at [0,0,0,5,5,5,5,5]; replay: Go ORet, so 'failed'. syn/pc.Mut does `b[i]=0; if b[i]!=0 {panic}` and never panics in Go. The body has a panic path [cell!=0]; L_par_tot_pc_Mut is REFUTED at [1,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]; replay: Go ORet, so 'failed'. syn/pc.Flag (without the cell-5 skip) instead triggers M5.
findings.fix: At the header's first entry in run_loop, havoc every own object the loop body may store to, so reads see an opaque term, conditions over it stay opaque, and Y6 refuses. Treat a store through the parameter (or a pointer derived from it) as making the op unsupported: a debt entry the model refuses (see M3), or a havoc of that cell. Amend Y1 (Q3).

findings.where: holon/frontends/go/terms.py:103 (op() keeps no integer width for symbolic operands); holon/gen/goloop.py:57 (affine reads ['op','*',iv,k] as exact integer arithmetic) and :90 (threshold)
findings.what: Index arithmetic of a narrow integer type wraps in Go, but the frontend's terms carry no width for symbolic arithmetic. goloop's affine() and threshold() treat a*iv+c as exact integers. A bound the wrapped value always meets becomes a model panic at a threshold Go never reaches. This falls under Y6's 'a non-affine index is Unsupported' (wrapping arithmetic is not affine over the integers), but it is not refused because the width is invisible to goloop.
findings.evidence: Reproduction (reviewer's own clone /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/clone at 9fa5e52; nothing under /home/user/HOLON touched): the synthetic Go module /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/syn (module syn; carrier syn/carrier.Blob = [256]byte; git-committed), a 0.2 frontend config at clone/spec/M97/lib/go_frontend.json pointing at it, `python3 -m holon extract go --milestone M97 --out-dir /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/synout`, the document copied to clone/spec/M97/facts/syn.go.extracted.json; then /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/scripts/drive.py (builds one Go-op document per group with holon.diagram.goops.document, runs holon.gen.goloop.shapes, generate, CompiledModel.build and decide with holon.mpipeline's write_pair and accepted, i.e. the real Bend check) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/scripts/replay.py (writes synthetic laws/results under M97 and runs holon.goreplay.build, i.e. the real generated Go test on a scratch copy of the module). syn/pd.Wrap2 has `tbl := make([]byte,256); for i := uint8(0); i < 200; i++ { if b[i]==5 {continue}; if b[i]!=0 {err}; tbl[i*2]=1 }`. In Go, i*2 is a uint8, so it never panics. The 0.2 body has a panic path [cell==0, ['op','*',iv,2] >= 256], and the model panics at i>=128. L_par_tot_pd_Wrap2 is REFUTED by Bend at 129 zeros then 71 fives; replay: Go ORet, so 'failed'. syn/pd.Wrap (without the skip) triggers M5 instead.
findings.fix: In the frontend's loop-body mode, keep the integer type of symbolic arithmetic. For example, wrap a narrower-than-int/uint64 op as an opaque or typed term. Then make goloop refuse a read or index condition whose arithmetic is not on a full-width int.

findings.where: holon/diagram/goops.py:27 (OP_KEYS carries no debt); holon/frontends/go/analyses.py:146-148 (body debt recorded, paths kept); holon/gen/goloop.py:175 (shape ignores debt)
findings.what: When the frontend meets an unsupported construct, it records a debt entry and still emits the paths. The Go-op document copies only OP_KEYS, so goloop never sees the debt and models those paths as faithful. A deferred recover turns every panic path into a return in Go, but the model keeps OPanic. Y1 makes such a construct 'a debt entry, as in a path enumeration'; nothing in Y3/Y6 refuses the op.
findings.evidence: Reproduction (reviewer's own clone /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/clone at 9fa5e52; nothing under /home/user/HOLON touched): the synthetic Go module /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/syn (module syn; carrier syn/carrier.Blob = [256]byte; git-committed), a 0.2 frontend config at clone/spec/M97/lib/go_frontend.json pointing at it, `python3 -m holon extract go --milestone M97 --out-dir /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/synout`, the document copied to clone/spec/M97/facts/syn.go.extracted.json; then /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/scripts/drive.py (builds one Go-op document per group with holon.diagram.goops.document, runs holon.gen.goloop.shapes, generate, CompiledModel.build and decide with holon.mpipeline's write_pair and accepted, i.e. the real Bend check) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/scripts/replay.py (writes synthetic laws/results under M97 and runs holon.goreplay.build, i.e. the real generated Go test on a scratch copy of the module). syn/ph.Rec has `defer func(){ if r := recover(); r != nil { err = errors.New(...) } }()` and a loop that panics when b[i]==9. The document's coverage.debt has {function: syn/ph.Rec, kind: unsupported, what: 'deferred call that may recover from a panic (panic paths would return)'}. The loop body still has the panic path [cell==9]. L_par_tot_ph_Rec is REFUTED by Bend at [9,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]; in Go, Rec returns a non-nil error.
findings.fix: Carry the function's unsupported debt into the op entry or the loop body (e.g. paths null, or an 'unsupported' list), and make goloop.shape refuse such an op. At minimum, refuse a may-recover defer (Q5).

findings.where: holon/goreplay.py:75-78 (concretize: a*k + c); holon/gen/goloop.py:443 (A-goloop-cells text) and op_text's comment line
findings.what: The model consumes node k of the cell list at index init+k, so node k is param[a*(init+k)+c]. concretize() writes it at a*k+c. For an op whose loop starts at init > 0, the replay therefore runs the real code on a different blob than the model's witness means. A correct REFUTED then 'fails' and is binned model_defect (F1); a wrong one could also pass by accident. The ledger text 'cell k is the parameter's cell a*k + c' and the model comment state the same off-by-init formula. Y6/Y9 write 'a*k + c' too (Q2).

findings.where: holon/gen/goloop.py:246-266 (continue_value raises; panic_witness and all_continue call it for every index); :607 (candidates); holon/codecrun.py:218 (catches only ir.IRError); holon/mpipeline.py:759 (no try around CR.decide)
findings.what: shape() accepts an op whose body paths partition the values, yet some index may have no continue path. Examples: an iteration that always returns, or a panic threshold after which every value panics or errs. panic_witness() asks for a continue value at every index, including those after the panic index, whose cells the model never reads. all_continue() asks for all of them too. continue_value raises Unsupported, which escapes GG.decide, codecrun.decide and mpipeline, so `holon run --milestone M3` aborts for every law instead of recording UNKNOWN with a reason as Y6 requires.
findings.evidence: Reproduction (reviewer's own clone /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/clone at 9fa5e52; nothing under /home/user/HOLON touched): the synthetic Go module /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/syn (module syn; carrier syn/carrier.Blob = [256]byte; git-committed), a 0.2 frontend config at clone/spec/M97/lib/go_frontend.json pointing at it, `python3 -m holon extract go --milestone M97 --out-dir /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/synout`, the document copied to clone/spec/M97/facts/syn.go.extracted.json; then /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/scripts/drive.py (builds one Go-op document per group with holon.diagram.goops.document, runs holon.gen.goloop.shapes, generate, CompiledModel.build and decide with holon.mpipeline's write_pair and accepted, i.e. the real Bend check) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/scripts/replay.py (writes synthetic laws/results under M97 and runs holon.goreplay.build, i.e. the real generated Go test on a scratch copy of the module). pe.Early (returns at i==7), pc.Flag and pd.Wrap all pass shape(). candidates() raises: 'pe_Early: no cell value continues the loop at index 7', 'pc_Flag: ... at index 2', 'pd_Wrap: ... at index 128'. GG.decide propagates it (drive.py prints 'decide RAISED Unsupported'), and codecrun.decide does not catch it (code at codecrun.py:208-220).
findings.fix: In panic_witness, require continue values only before k: fill later cells with any byte, e.g. 0, and skip a k that some earlier index cannot reach. Make all_continue stop at the first index without one. Catch Unsupported in GG.decide and return UNKNOWN with the reason. Settle Y7's wording (Q6).

findings.where: holon/frontends/go/paths.py:520-521 (assume init <= iv on the phi) with holon/frontends/go/flow.py:498 (init is the compared term's, phi + k)
findings.what: go.loops' init is the effective initial value of the compared term x = phi + k (flow._counted), but run_loop binds ['iv', name] to the phi and assumes init <= phi. For every range loop (go/ssa starts the phi at -1 and compares phi+1) and every counted loop testing i+k, this is false on the first iteration. The reasoner then proves first-iteration bounds safe, or prunes first-iteration branches, so the loop body omits reachable panics. The committed M3 document holds such bodies, e.g. (*morph-l2/common/batch.BatchData).Append: a range loop with ['<=',['const',0],['iv','i']] and test ['<',['op','+',['iv','i'],['const',1]],len]. goloop refuses these loops today (iv null; exit not found; or no cell read left), so no status changes now. But the facts are wrong against Y1 ('paths are the loop-free paths of one iteration').
findings.evidence: Reproduction (reviewer's own clone /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/clone at 9fa5e52; nothing under /home/user/HOLON touched): the synthetic Go module /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/syn (module syn; carrier syn/carrier.Blob = [256]byte; git-committed), a 0.2 frontend config at clone/spec/M97/lib/go_frontend.json pointing at it, `python3 -m holon extract go --milestone M97 --out-dir /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/synout`, the document copied to clone/spec/M97/facts/syn.go.extracted.json; then /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/scripts/drive.py (builds one Go-op document per group with holon.diagram.goops.document, runs holon.gen.goloop.shapes, generate, CompiledModel.build and decide with holon.mpipeline's write_pair and accepted, i.e. the real Bend check) and /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HOLON/13f9caff-002b-57ac-9895-57449b3592cb/scratchpad/br/scripts/replay.py (writes synthetic laws/results under M97 and runs holon.goreplay.build, i.e. the real generated Go test on a scratch copy of the module). syn/pf.Range (`for i := range b { if b[i]!=0 {err}; prev[i-1]=1 }`; Go panics at i==0) has no panic path in its 0.2 body. syn/pf.Offset (`for i := 0; i+1 < 8; i++ {...; prev[i-1]=1}`) assumes ['<=',['const',1],['iv','i']] and has no panic path. syn/pf.Offset2 (`if i==0 && b[i]==4 {panic}`) has its i==0 branch pruned: only continue and exit paths remain, although go.loops records exits ['panic'].
findings.fix: In run_loop, assume init - k <= phi (k the header comparison's offset, available from flow._iv_of), or bind the phi to ['op','-',['iv',name],k] so that ['iv'] is the compared term. Settle Y1's wording (Q4).

findings.where: holon/diagram/goops.py:166 (key_space 'byte' asserted, never checked); holon/gen/goloop.py:238 (byte samples, unsigned U32 comparisons); holon/goreplay.py:157 (x[i] = byte(v))
findings.what: Nothing checks that the carrier is (a pointer to) an array of bytes. For an int8 element the model's U32 comparisons are unsigned, and byte witnesses 128..255 are negative in Go. Negative constants become U32 literals. Wider elements are never sampled above 255. The generated replay test does not compile for a non-byte element, so replay-go refuses the whole run.
findings.evidence: Code reading of the three places; Go's assignability rules make `x[i] = byte(v)` a compile error for a non-byte element.
findings.fix: Refuse in goops or goloop a carrier whose element type is not byte/uint8 (the frontend would need to export the carrier's underlying type).

findings.where: holon/frontends/go/paths.py:163-196 (run_loop) with :507 (only the outer header is cut)
findings.what: run_loop cuts only the outer header. An inner loop in the body is unrolled by ordinary stepping, and PathLimit is checked only between steps. A single path round an inner loop whose test the reasoner decides each time therefore never ends, and `holon extract go` (and G1) hangs under config 0.2. Config 0.1 never iterates a loop.
findings.evidence: syn/pi.Spin (`for i := 0; i < 4; i++ { for b[i] != 0 {} }`) as its own document (clone/spec/M96): the 0.2 extraction was killed by `timeout 90` (real 1m30s, 100% CPU); the same config at 0.1 finished in 0.12 s.
findings.fix: Count steps per path in run_loop (or refuse a loop body containing another loop's header) and end the body with a path_limit debt entry.

findings.where: holon/goreplay.py:187-189 (HEAD only) and :199 (make_workspace copies the working tree)
findings.what: The report attests morph_commit, but goreplay only checks `git rev-parse HEAD` and then copies the working tree, including uncommitted and untracked files. holon.replay.check_checkout, used by the I4 replay, also refuses a dirty tree. Neither does goreplay verify the copied files against the Go document's extraction.inputs sha256.
findings.evidence: With an uncommitted edit to syn/pc/pc.go (Mut no longer zeroes b[i]), replay.py reported L_par_tot_pc_Mut 'passed' (panic:impossible) under morph_commit = HEAD. With the tree restored, the same witness is 'failed'.
findings.fix: Call holon.replay.check_checkout (or an equivalent porcelain check of the copied trees), or verify each copied input file against go_doc['extraction']['inputs'].

findings.where: holon/goreplay.py:102 (fn, op, alias pasted into Go source), :93-95 (carrier path), :172-178 (_module_dir)
findings.what: The Go test is generated from the committed Go-op document. Its function names are checked only for an upper-case first letter, and op names, import paths and the carrier type are not re-checked. The document is a generated artifact; goreplay does not check that it is fresh, so a tampered document injects Go source that `go test` runs. _module_dir loops forever on an absolute package dir and can climb out of the scratch workspace.
findings.evidence: _module_dir(Path(<syn module>), '/etc/ssl') did not return (killed by a 20 s timeout). The rest is code reading.
findings.fix: Validate op names (NAME), function names (Go identifiers), import paths (Go path syntax, no quotes) and package dirs (relative, no '..') before generating; or check that the Go-op document is what `holon codecs` writes now.

findings.where: holon/gen/goloop.py:585-592 and :656 (difference from side_value/evaluate); holon/goreplay.py:254 (expected from evaluate); goloop.CompiledModel.build (.mjs built, never run)
findings.what: Candidates, the record's difference and the replay's 'expected' all come from goloop's Python mirror of the shape. The compiled model is only Bend-checked through the counter-law; the .mjs is built but never run. I24's linked decide instead searches and evaluates witnesses on the compiled model. The status is still Bend's. But if the mirror and the generated Bend ever drift, the recorded difference and the replay's expectation would be wrong. Y7 also says the witness 'comes from the compiled model'.
findings.evidence: Code reading, compared with holon/gen/linked.py decide/_fill_search (compiled-model fills/probes).
findings.fix: Evaluate the two sides at the witness with the compiled .mjs (as holon/gen/linked.py does) and record that; keep the Python mirror only as a cross-check.

findings.what: The trip-count gate is computed over every supported op of the component, not over the ops the law names. One op with another trip count makes every law of the component UNKNOWN, single-op totality laws included. The bound then says 'no candidate refutes it in the compiled model' when no candidate was checked.
findings.evidence: Group 'mixed' {pa.Check (n 4), pc.Mut (n 8)}: L_par_tot_pa_Check, REFUTED in group 'pair', becomes UNKNOWN; every attempt is 'the ops' loops differ in trip count'.
findings.fix: Gate on the named ops' trip counts (and cell maps, B1), and word the bound for the not-searched case.

findings.where: holon/gen/goloop.py:546-550 (binder List<&2, U32>) and :658 (witness written without checks)
findings.what: The counter-law's binder ranges over U32 lists of any length, while the carrier is n byte cells. Bend's acceptance therefore does not establish that the witness is a carrier value: a shorter list makes the model return the exit outcome early. Today candidates() always give n byte cells, so validity rests on the untrusted generator, not on the checker or the record.
findings.evidence: Code reading of run_<op>/step_<op> (Nil gives Fin{exit}) and decide().
findings.fix: Before writing a REFUTED record, check len(cells) == n for every named op and 0 <= cell <= 255; or state the length and byte range in the counter-law (Q8).

questions: Q1 (Y6, Y9): Y6 gives each op its own read a*k+c, and Y9 concretizes 'the carrier value whose array cell a*k + c (Y6's read) is cell k' as if a law had one read. Should a law whose named ops read different cells (stride, offset or init) be Unsupported? B1 shows the alternative yields false REFUTED records whose replay passes.
Q2 (Y6, Y9): the model consumes node k at iteration index init+k, so its cell is a*(init+k)+c. 'a*k + c' is right only for init 0. Amend both rules (and the A-goloop-cells text)?

Q3 (Y1): 'Memory the loop writes is read as at the loop's entry' is unsound once a condition over such memory folds (fresh allocations read as constants), and the frontend drops writes through the parameter entirely. Should loop-written memory be havocked at the header, so that such conditions stay opaque and Y6 refuses the op?

Q4 (Y1): 'the header binds the induction variable with init <= iv assumed' uses go.loops' init, which is the compared term's (phi + k), while the induction variable bound is the phi. For range loops (phi from -1) and offset tests the assumption is false on the first iteration. Which variable is meant?
Q5 (Y3, Y6): the op entry carries no frontend debt. Should Y6 refuse an op whose function has an unsupported construct, in particular a deferred call that may recover?

Q6 (Y7): 'every other cell the smallest byte value that keeps its iteration on a continue path' is undefined when no continue value exists (after the panic index, or at an iteration that always returns). What should the candidate be?
Q7 (Y6): should index or read arithmetic of a narrow integer type (uint8/int8 wraparound) be outside the class? The frontend's terms carry no width.

Q8 (Y6, Y7): the counter-law's binder is List<&2, U32> of any length. Should the counter-law (or the record check) pin the witness to n byte cells, so that a Bend-accepted counter-law alone establishes a carrier value?

Q9 (Y7): 'then the sequence of continue values', of which op? The implementation uses the first supported op of the component by name, possibly one the law does not name, and gates on every op's trip count (m6).
